row.evidence: Later's pricing page and its help-centre plan-availability guide list no SCIM or provisioning feature on any plan; SSO is marked unavailable on Free, Starter, Growth and Scale ("Legacy Enterprise plan only"), and users are invited and removed manually by the account owner.
row.notes: Status unchanged (none). Team plan changed from Starter to Growth: Starter ($18.75/mo billed yearly) is limited to 1 user with no extra users, so the cheapest multi-user tier is Growth ($37.50/mo billed yearly, 2 users; Scale $82.50/mo, 4 users). Pricing is flat per account plus user add-ons ($3.75/user/mo on the plan cards, $5 in the FAQ; see conflicts), so per-user fields are null. The pricing table's "Single Sign-on (SSO)" row means one Later login across Later products, not SAML; the help centre says SSO is legacy-Enterprise-only, so sso_plan is null. No SCIM, SAML, IdP app or user-management API found.

scim.notes: No SCIM documented; absence inferred from the full plan-availability reference, the pricing page and help-centre search (0 results for "scim" and "okta").

entra.notes: No Later entry in the Microsoft Entra SaaS-app tutorial TOC.

fallbacks.notes: Users are invited by email and removed manually by the account owner (desktop only).

conflicts.text: Extra-user price: plan cards say "Extra users ( $3.75 USD/month each)" (annual view), while the pricing FAQ says "$5 per additional user".

The pricing table marks "Single Sign-on (SSO)" as Yes on paid plans, but defines it as one Later login across Later products; the help-centre plan guide marks SSO as not available on Free/Starter/Growth/Scale ("Legacy Enterprise plan only").

searched: https://later.com/sitemap.xml (marketing sitemap: no API, developer, security or SSO pages)
help-centre search API (help.later.com): scim (0), okta (0), saml, single sign-on, api, remove user, user provisioning, csv
open_questions: Whether the legacy Enterprise SSO was SAML with the customer IdP (not described publicly).
Whether Later offers any public user-management API (none found in sitemap or help centre).
Later Influence (creator marketing product) was not researched separately.
